Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, David Strah, Jim Levin and guest Dr. Frank Lilly, only opendly gay member of the presidential commission on AIDS, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2.Dr. Frank Lilly goes into detail about the reasons for his selection and the commissions mandate among other things. COMMERCIAL: San Francisco AIDS Foundation 3.Continuation of interview with Dr. Frank Lily COMMERCIAL: Human Rights Campaign Fund 4. Dr. Burton Lee meets with AIDS activists 5.News Watch,Stirling Colgate has developed a software that projects levels of AIDS infection 6.Meridian, Mississipi citizens protest the existence of a local gay bar called Poppers 7. University of California doctor is testing a drug to help with impotency. 8.Article on lesbianism in magazine called, "New Woman" 9. Announcement regarding the October 11th March on Washington COMMERCIAL:First Hand 10.GCN Sports interviews bowler Gutter George from [VBL] 11. Lavender Health, Interview with Ellen Zaltzberg, an Education Coordinator of the Office of Gay and Lesbian Health Concerns of the NYC Department of Health, talks about homophobia 12.Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1.Show Bitz, interview with Charles Bush COMMERCIAL:Manscape 2.Naming Names, "Money Magazine" recieves criticism after publishing an article about a gay couple's finances COMMERCIAL:The Islanders Club 3.Just Ask Raz,Announcement about play, "Love Goddess" among other things COMMERCIAL:The Monster 4.Inside Out, Introducing Paco Rabanne 5.Media Watch, Interview with Arthur Kirson, Cabaret Performer
